description: This file declares the PackageManager class, which manages package download and installation notifications within the WPEFramework plugin architecture. It includes interface implementations, nested notification handler class, and external dependencies.

classes.name: PackageManager
classes.description: Main plugin class managing package download and installation, implementing plugin interfaces and handling notifications.

classes.name: NotificationHandler
classes.description: Nested class handling remote connection and package download/installation notifications.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the PackageManager with the given service shell.

methods.description: Deinitializes the PackageManager with the given service shell.
